The parser produces a tree of :class:`HtmlElement` objects that mimics the
small subset of the ``lxml.html`` element API used throughout Inscriptis:

from typing import Dict, List, Optional


class Comment:
    """Sentinel class used to mark comment nodes (``tag is Comment``)."""


VOID_ELEMENTS = {
    "area",
    "base",
    "br",
    "col",
    "embed",
    "hr",
    "img",
    "input",
    "link",
    "meta",
    "param",
    "source",
    "track",
    "wbr",
}


class HtmlElement:
    """A lightweight stand-in for ``lxml.html.HtmlElement``."""

    __slots__ = ("tag", "attrib", "text", "tail", "children")

    def __init__(self, tag, attrib: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None):
        self.tag = tag
        self.attrib = attrib if attrib is not None else {}
        self.text: Optional[str] = None
        self.tail: Optional[str] = None
        self.children: List["HtmlElement"] = []

    def __iter__(self):
        return iter(self.children)

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.children)

    def __repr__(self):  # pragma: no cover - debugging helper
        return f"<HtmlElement {self.tag!r}>"


class _TreeBuilder(HTMLParser):
    """Builds a tree of :class:`HtmlElement` objects from HTML markup."""

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.root = HtmlElement("--root--")
        self._stack = [self.root]

    def _append_data(self, data: str) -> None:
        if not data:
            return
        parent = self._stack[-1]
        if parent.children:
            last = parent.children[-1]
            last.tail = (last.tail or "") + data
        else:
            parent.text = (parent.text or "") + data

        tag = tag.lower()
        attrib = {name.lower(): (value if value is not None else "") for name, value in attrs}
        element = HtmlElement(tag, attrib)
        self._stack[-1].children.append(element)
        if tag not in VOID_ELEMENTS:
            self._stack.append(element)

    def handle_startendtag(self, tag, attrs):
        tag = tag.lower()
        attrib = {name.lower(): (value if value is not None else "") for name, value in attrs}
        element = HtmlElement(tag, attrib)
        self._stack[-1].children.append(element)

            return

        for index in range(len(self._stack) - 1, 0, -1):

                del self._stack[index:]

        self._append_data(data)

    def handle_comment(self, data):
        comment = HtmlElement(Comment)
        comment.text = data
        self._stack[-1].children.append(comment)

def fromstring(html: str) -> HtmlElement:
    """Parse the given HTML string and return the root :class:`HtmlElement`.

    This mimics the relevant behavior of ``lxml.html.fromstring``:

    * if the document starts with ``<html`` or ``<!doctype`` the parsed
      ``<html>`` element is returned as is.
    * otherwise, the HTML is treated as a fragment. If it contains a single
      top-level element (and no surrounding text) that element is returned
      directly; otherwise all top-level nodes are wrapped inside a
      synthetic ``<body>`` element.
    """

    builder.feed(html)
    builder.close()
    root = builder.root

        only_child = root.children[0]
        if not (only_child.tail and only_child.tail.strip()):
            return only_child

    body.text = root.text
    body.children = root.children
    return body
